newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Westpac sees competition remaining intense.
newsitem.headline: Westpac sees competition remaining intense.

text.p: Westpac Banking Corp managing director Bob Joss said on Wednesday he expected competition to remain intense and that earnings improvement would depend on active balance sheet management, improved efficiency and higher non-interest income.
"Looking ahead, competition is expected to remain intense," Joss said in a statement released with the group's first half year profit result.

"Earnings improvement will depend upon continued active capital and balance sheet management, improved operational efficiency, achieving the full potential of regional bank integrations, sound risk management and improving non-interest income," Joss said.
